claims: Justin Bieber is scheduled to perform at Coachella 2026.
Justin Bieber's set at Coachella 2026 will stream live on YouTube.
Justin Bieber's set is scheduled for Saturday, April 11, 2026, at 11:25 p.m. PDT.
Justin Bieber's performance will be available on the official Coachella YouTube channel.
Coachella runs across two weekends, April 10–12 and April 17–19, 2026.
